# 2 Chronicles Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-returned Jehoshaphat king-of Judah to his-house in-peace to-Jerusalem.

**2** And-he-went-out to-his-face Jehu son-of Hanani the-seer and-he-said to the-king Jehoshaphat to-the-wicked you-help and-to-haters-of YHWH you-love and-in-this upon-you wrath from-before YHWH.

**3** Nevertheless good things are-found in-you for you-removed the-Asherim from the-land and-you-fixed your-heart to-seek God.

**4** And-he-dwelt Jehoshaphat in-Jerusalem and-he-went-out again in-the-people from-Beer-sheba to hill-country-of Ephraim and-he-brought-them-back to YHWH God-of their-fathers.

**5** And-he-set judges in-the-land in-all cities-of Judah the-fortified city by-city.

**6** And-he-said to the-judges see what you are-doing for not for-man you-judge but for-YHWH and-He-is with-you in-matter-of judgment.

**7** And-now let-be fear-of YHWH upon-you guard and-do for there-is-no with-YHWH our-God injustice and-not lifting-of-faces and-not taking-of bribes.

**8** And-also in-Jerusalem he-appointed Jehoshaphat from the-Levites and-the-priests and-from-heads-of the-fathers of-Israel for-judgment-of YHWH and-for-disputes and-they-returned to-Jerusalem.

**9** And-he-commanded upon-them saying thus you-shall-do in-fear-of YHWH in-faithfulness and-with-a-heart complete.

**10** And-every dispute that comes to-you from-your-brothers the-dwelling in-their-cities between blood to-blood between law and-commandment statutes and-judgments and-you-shall-warn-them and-not they-shall-be-guilty against-YHWH and-there-shall-be wrath on-you and-on your-brothers thus you-shall-do and-not you-shall-be-guilty.

**11** And-behold Amariah the-chief priest is-over-you for-every matter-of YHWH and-Zebadiah son-of Ishmael the-ruler of-house-of Judah for-every matter-of the-king and-officers the-Levites before-you be-strong and-do and-may-YHWH-be with the-good.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **19:2**: to-the-wicked you-help — Jehu's rebuke directly addresses Jehoshaphat's alliance with Ahab. The verb 'azar (to help) connects military assistance with moral complicity.

- **19:6**: not for-man you-judge but for-YHWH — Justice is divine business. Judges act as God's representatives; their verdicts carry divine weight and divine accountability.

- **19:11**: matter-of YHWH...matter-of the-king — The dual jurisdiction system separates religious and civil authority, anticipating later institutional developments in Judean governance.


— EMET
